name: YouTube Scraper
description: YouTube scraper for Python and the command line: search results, a channel's uploads with its stats, and full video metadata with exact views and likes, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no YouTube Data API key, proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: search
commands.help: YouTube search results for a query
commands.description: YouTube search results without the Data API — views, channel, duration.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: lang
inputs.description: Interface language (hl), e.g. en, it, de.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many videos to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered videos.

commands.name: channel
commands.help: a channel's videos, shorts or streams with channel stats
commands.description: A channel's uploads with views, duration and channel stats.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.description: Handle (@NASA), channel id (UC…) or channel URL.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many videos to deliver at most (1–150). You pay only for delivered videos.

commands.name: videos
commands.help: full metadata for one or more videos
commands.description: Full metadata per video id — exact views and likes, length, category, captions.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many videos to deliver at most (1–20). You pay only for delivered videos.
